definitions.explanation: Casual abbreviation of デジタルカメラ (digital camera). Refers specifically to a standalone digital camera, as distinct from a smartphone camera.

examples.japanese: デジカメで{写真|しゃしん}を{撮|と}った。
examples.english: I took a photo with my digital camera.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しいデジカメが{欲|ほ}しい。
examples.english: I want a new digital camera.

examples.japanese: スマホがあれば{十分|じゅうぶん}なので、デジカメを{使|つか}う{機会|きかい}はほとんどなくなった。
examples.english: Since smartphones are enough, I rarely have a chance to use a digital camera anymore.

notes:
Abbreviation of デジタルカメラ. デジカメ is the everyday spoken form; デジタルカメラ is more formal or used in writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- デジカメで{撮|と}る: to shoot with a digital camera
- デジカメ{写真|しゃしん}: digital-camera photo
- コンパクトデジカメ: compact digital camera

SIMILAR WORDS:
- デジタルカメラ: digital camera — the full, formal form
- {一眼|いちがん}カメラ: single-lens (DSLR/mirrorless) camera — the higher-end category
- スマホカメラ: smartphone camera — competing category that has largely replaced casual デジカメ use
